## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与改后行为

Describe the concrete trigger and before/after result.

## Validation / 验证

List relevant checks actually run, their results, and any skipped checks.

## Compatibility and documentation / 兼容与文档

- Does this affect installed policies, existing entry points, host boundaries or explicit model choices?
- Are corresponding English and Chinese docs updated?
- For model-policy changes, link evidence and state what remains unverified.
